Get Rich Or Die Tryin’ (2005) 
Get Rich or Die Tryin’ follows Marcus, a young man growing up in Queens who is searching for a way to escape the circumstances surrounding him. After being exposed to the streets at an early age, Marcus finds himself caught between two different paths, the money and reputation that come from the drug game and his passion for music. As he begins pursuing rap, he has to navigate relationships, loss, street pressure, and the obstacles standing between him and the life he wants. 

In pop culture, the movie was closely connected to 50 Cent’s rise from the streets to becoming one of hip-hop’s biggest stars. His real-life experiences heavily influenced the story, making the film feel like an extension of the image and narrative he had already established through his music. 

On a broader cultural level, Get Rich or Die Tryin’ explores survival, ambition, trauma, poverty, and using creativity as a way to change your circumstances. Music becomes more than entertainment for Marcus, it represents a possible escape and a chance to create something different from the environment he came from. The movie also reflects the complicated reality of the “get rich” mentality, showing both the attraction of quick money and the personal costs that can come with it.
